verdict.rationale: Snyk ships an MCP server (verified via handshake probe) and documents natural-language prompting of coding agents ("scan my directory for security issues") plus slash commands like /snyk-fix and CLI agentic remediation flows, showing users can operate Snyk via natural-language commands through AI coding assistants. missing for 10: independent/community corroboration specifically of natural-language command usage (evidence is mostly first-party docs plus a first-party probe), and no evidence of broader NL coverage beyond fix/scan prompts.
